## Activity

During July 2023, East City Eye Clinic completed 158 captures. Activity was delivered in line with the clinic’s planned operations, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 158 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.3 per cent. The result indicates that most captures were suitable for review. The ungradable captures remain included in the activity total and are reported separately to support monitoring of image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 45 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Overall, the July 2023 activity at East City Eye Clinic was completed with the reported level of image quality and grading turnaround.
